relation_kind.description: Relation semantic. Cross-Realm constraint: structural relations 'contains' and 'belongs_to' MUST NOT cross Realm (resolved from_ref and to_ref MUST share the same realm_id). Reducer-enforced — see models/relation.md §3 cardinality table and §4 cross-Realm rules. Weak-semantic kinds (references, mentions, derived_from, summarized_from, depends_on, blocks, assigned_to, has_default_view) MAY cross Realm subject to two-sided authorization.

rank.description: Top-level rank string for ordered relations (e.g. contains-list-flow position). Encoding follows conformance/encoding.md §9. Aligned with Space.rank so all rank-bearing canonical objects expose rank at the top level instead of fields.rank.

fields.description: Edge metadata. MUST NOT contain a 'rank' key — rank moved to the top level in v1 to align with Space.rank.

state.description: Relation state. 'tombstone' covers both deletion and redaction; the originating reason is preserved on the cx.relation.tombstone / cx.redaction event, not on the materialized object.

state_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent state transition. MUST be set when state != 'active'; MUST be the created_at of the corresponding cx.relation.tombstone / redaction Event. Aligns with Space.state_changed_at and the common-fields rule in models/common-fields.md §3.

ref.description: Typed canonical reference. Allowed kinds: realm, space, actor_profile, flow, message, morph, relation, event, view, blob metadata ID, content-addressed blob ref (sha256 / sha3_256 / blake3 / sha512), or DID. Space is a valid Relation endpoint (board/list containers, e.g. board --contains--> list). The sha512 form is aligned with blob.schema.json and notification.schema.json so any content-addressed blob ref accepted in those schemas is also accepted as a Relation endpoint.
